veranderings.rede: 'Behou' is the precise, natural verb for keeping a property unchanged; 'gehou' reads loosely.

veranderings.na: Oorgiet skei die stowwe nie heeltemal nie
veranderings.rede: 'Skei nie volmaak nie' without an object is wooden; 'skei die stowwe nie heeltemal nie' is plainer and keeps the meaning.
